name: Quel'Lithien Lodge
summary: Farstrider rangers keep watch at Quel'Lithien Lodge, amid the blighted woods of the Eastern Plaguelands. The high elven hunting lodge stands among the northern hills near the entrance to Quel'Thalas. The Scourge surround it, and Forsaken agents hunt its rangers as they guard old elven archives.

sections.title: A Ranger Camp in the Blight
sections.body: Before the Third War, Farstriders kept camp at Quel'Lithien on the road to Quel'Thalas. The lodge held records of the ranger order. Then the Scourge swept through Lordaeron and into the elven kingdom, and the lodge's fortunes worsened. Now its rangers watch over the corrupted forest. They are one of only two major concentrations of high elves left in Lordaeron.

sections.title: Hunted in the Plaguelands
sections.body: Nathanos Blightcaller has sent Horde champions to infiltrate Quel'Lithien Lodge. Once a solitary human Ranger Lord, he trained alongside these very elves. He seeks the Quel'Thalas Registry, an official record of the ranger order and elven lineages. Nathanos has ordered the lodge's defenders slaughtered so the record can be taken. The rangers face a siege from former allies and the undead around them.

faq.q: Why are there living high elves in the Eastern Plaguelands?
faq.answer: Quel'Lithien has long been a Farstrider camp. Its high elven rangers remain here after the Scourge laid waste to the region. They hold one of Lordaeron's last elven footholds near the road to Quel'Thalas.

faq.q: Are the elves at Quel'Lithien Lodge part of the Alliance?
faq.answer: No. The lodge welcomes Alliance travelers and is openly hostile toward the Horde. Yet it is an autonomous high elven settlement, without formal support or direction from Stormwind or Ironforge.

faq.q: Why does Nathanos Blightcaller target the lodge?
faq.answer: Nathanos Blightcaller sends Horde agents to seize the Quel'Thalas Registry. The lodge's archives hold this important historical record of elven ranger personnel and lineages.

faq.q: How does Quel'Lithien differ from Quel'Danil Lodge?
faq.answer: Both were historic high elven hunting lodges. Quel'Danil lies among friendly Wildhammer dwarves in the Hinterlands. Quel'Lithien stands isolated in the Eastern Plaguelands, between blighted ruins and the closed gates of Quel'Thalas.

angles.text: As a hunter, you see Farstriders carrying centuries of classical Thalassian marksmanship. They rely on those survival skills in a hostile wilderness, cut off from civil society.
As a member of the Horde, you are sent here from Marris Stead on Nathanos Blightcaller's orders. You are to seize high elven records by force.
